title: Boom Wash – Multi-Purpose Foaming Cleaning Powder (300ml)
description:
Keep your household drains clean and fresh with Boom Wash, a fast-foaming cleaner designed to tackle grease, dirt, and stubborn buildup.

Key Features:

🫧 Fast-foaming cleaning action

✨ Helps remove grease, fats, soap residue & dirt

🚰 Helps reduce drain buildup and clogging

🌿 Helps eliminate unpleasant odours

🏠 Suitable for kitchen sinks, washbasins, floor drains, toilet drains & washing machine drainage areas

⏱️ Easy to use – approximately 30-minute soaking time

📦 Pack Size: 300ml (supplier-listed; verify on packaging)

Boom Wash – Powerful Foam, Easier Cleaning!
